name: Bran Batter-Cakes
description: Historical recipe from Miss Leslie's Complete Cookery (1851). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: two table-spoonfuls of brewer's yeast or three if home-made
ingredients.originalText: two table-spoonfuls of brewer's yeast or three if home-made
ingredients.quantityText: two table-spoonfuls of brewer's yeast or three if home-made

instructions.text: Mix a quart of bran with a handful of wheat flour, and a level tea-spoonful of salt
Pour in sufficient milk-warm water to make a thick batter
Add two table-spoonfuls of brewer's yeast, or three, if home-made
Cover it, and set it by the fire to rise
Half an hour before you begin to bake, you may add a salt-spoonful of soda, melted in a little warm water
Bake it like buckwheat cakes, on a griddle

source.author: Eliza Leslie
source.originalInstructions:
1. Mix a quart of bran with a handful of wheat flour, and a level tea-spoonful of salt
2. Pour in sufficient milk-warm water to make a thick batter
3. Add two table-spoonfuls of brewer's yeast, or three, if home-made
4. Stir it very hard
5. Cover it, and set it by the fire to rise
6. Half an hour before you begin to bake, you may add a salt-spoonful of soda, melted in a little warm water
7. Bake it like buckwheat cakes, on a griddle
